claim: The inspected public primary-source package for the D18/PY-IT/eC9 anchor is not sufficient to classify the ternary useful-work evidence as independently reproducible from raw machine-readable data: the article states supporting data are in the main text and Supplementary Information, while additional data are available from the corresponding author on request; PMC exposes the Supplementary Information as a 34.3 MB PDF.
important_boundary: This status is about public reproducibility of the inspected package, not truth/falsity of the paper and not evidence that raw data do not exist. Author-supplied or newly deposited raw data can revise the status.
falsifier: A public provenance-complete raw/minimally processed dataset with sample/device identities and a deterministic processing path sufficient to reconstruct the ternary field-generation or stabilized-power claim.
